title: LitReview Arena：文献综述智能体的竞技场式评估平台
summary: LitReview Arena 是一个竞技场式评估平台，用于评估文献综述智能体。它采用结构化协议，由领域专家对匿名草稿进行多维评分，收集约3000条专家判断。结果显示最强系统仅23%胜率，而智能体LLM显著优于基础模型。现有LLM评判与专家不一致，新提出的LitJudge校准器将一致性提升至0.78。
summary_en: LitReview Arena is a battle-style evaluation platform for literature review agents, using expert judgments on five criteria. Strongest systems win only 23% against human drafts; agentic LLMs outperform base models by 60%. LLM-as-judge misalignment (rho=0.467) is corrected by LitJudge to 0.78.
